subject.title: fix(sessions): keep Matrix DM session keys case-distinct per peer

question: Should this proven mitigation land now for the two channel-aware Matrix DM scopes while `per-peer` remains tracked, or must the branch include a migration-safe `per-peer` solution first?
rationale: Both choices affect a persisted session-key privacy boundary: delaying leaves two fixable scopes exposed, while landing accepts a documented residual collision in `per-peer`.

options.title: Land scoped mitigation
options.body: Merge the tested channel-aware fix now and keep the canonical issue open for a separately designed `per-peer` migration.

options.title: Require complete isolation
options.body: Hold this PR until one migration-safe design covers `per-peer` without changing every channel's identity semantics.
